text_en: In the third year of King Hoshea son of Elah of Israel, Hezekiah son of King Ahaz of Judah began to reign.
text_cn: 以色列王厄拉的儿子曷舍亚三年，阿哈次的儿子希则克雅登极为犹大王。

text_en: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abi daughter of Zechariah.
text_cn: 他登极时年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王凡二十九年；他的母亲名叫阿彼雅，是则加黎雅的女儿。

text_en: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord just as his ancestor David had done.
text_cn: 希则克雅行了上主视为正义的事，完全像他祖先达味所行的一样；

text_en: He removed the high places, broke down the pillars, and cut down the sacred pole. He broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, for until those days the people of Israel had made offerings to it; it was called Nehushtan.
text_cn: 他废除了高丘，毁坏了石柱，砍倒了木偶，打碎了梅瑟所制造的铜蛇，因为直到那时，以色列子民仍向铜蛇焚香，称为乃胡市堂。

text_en: He trusted in the Lord the God of Israel; so that there was no one like him among all the kings of Judah after him, or among those who were before him.
text_cn: 他信赖上主以色列的天主；在他前后的犹大列王中，没有一个可与他相比的。

text_en: For he held fast to the Lord ; he did not depart from following him but kept the commandments that the Lord commanded Moses.
text_cn: 他依靠上主，紧随不离，谨守上主颁给梅瑟的诫命。

text_en: The Lord was with him; wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and would not serve him.
text_cn: 因此，上主与他同在，他无论作什么，必都顺利，且摆脱了亚述王的羁绊，不再作他的藩属；

text_en: He attacked the Philistines as far as Gaza and its territory, from watchtower to fortified city.
text_cn: 又击败了培肋舍特人，直追到迦萨，占领了他们的土地，攻取了守望台和坚城。

text_en: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of King Hoshea son of Elah of Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria came up against Samaria, besieged it,
text_cn: 希则克雅王四年，即以色列王厄拉的儿子曷舍亚七年，亚述王沙耳玛乃色来进攻撒玛黎雅，围困了这城；

text_en: and at the end of three years, took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of King Hoshea of Israel, Samaria was taken.
text_cn: 三年年底攻下，即希则克雅王六年，以色列王曷舍亚九年，撒玛黎雅失陷。

text_en: The king of Assyria carried the Israelites away to Assyria, settled them in Halah, on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,
text_cn: 亚述王遂将以色列人掳往亚述，徙置在哈拉黑和靠近哥仓河的哈波尔，以及玛待各城内。

text_en: because they did not obey the voice of the Lord their God but transgressed his covenant—all that Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded; they neither listened nor obeyed.
text_cn: 这是因为他们没有听从上主，他们天主的声音，违反了他的盟约：凡上主的仆人梅瑟所吩咐的，他们一概没有听从，也没有遵行。

text_en: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, King Sennacherib of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
text_cn: 希则克雅王十四年，亚述王散乃黑黎布前来进攻犹大的一切坚城，都占领了。

text_en: King Hezekiah of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, “I have done wrong; withdraw from me; whatever you impose on me I will bear. ” The king of Assyria demanded of King Hezekiah of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
text_cn: 犹大王希则克雅于是派遣使者，到拉基士去见亚述王说：“我错了，请你退兵；凡你向我提出的条件，我都接受。”于是亚述王限令犹大王希则克雅缴纳三百"塔冷通"银子，三十"塔冷通"金子。

text_en: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king’s house.
text_cn: 希则克雅只得把上主殿内，和王宫府库所有的银子都交出来。

text_en: At that time Hezekiah stripped the gold from the doors of the temple of the Lord , and from the doorposts that King Hezekiah of Judah had overlaid and gave it to the king of Assyria.
text_cn: 同时，犹大王希则克雅将上主殿宇门上的金子和他自己包镶在门柱上的金子都剥下来，交给了亚述王。

text_en: The king of Assyria sent the Tartan, the Rabsaris, and the Rabshakeh with a great army from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. They went up and came to Jerusalem. When they arrived, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is on the highway to the Fuller’s Field.
text_cn: 亚述王从拉基士打发元帅、卫队长和大将军率领大军到耶路撒冷去见希则克雅。他们就上到耶路撒冷，一来到，就站在上池的水沟旁，漂布田间的大路上，

text_en: When they called for the king, there came out to them Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace, and Shebnah the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph, the recorder.
text_cn: 求见君王。希耳克雅的儿子厄里雅金家宰，舍布纳书记和阿撒夫的儿子约阿黑史官，出来迎接他们。

text_en: The Rabshakeh said to them, “Say to Hezekiah: Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: On what do you base this confidence of yours?
text_cn: 大将军对他们说：“你们去告诉希则克雅说：大王，亚述王这样说：你所依靠的，算得什么依靠？

text_en: Do you think that mere words are strategy and power for war? On whom do you now rely, that you have rebelled against me?
text_cn: 你想空口说话，就是战略和战斗的力量吗？如今你靠谁来背叛我？

text_en: See, you are relying now on Egypt, that broken reed of a staff, which will pierce the hand of anyone who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who rely on him.
text_cn: 现在你看，你依靠的埃及是一根破裂的芦杖；谁依靠这杖，它就刺伤谁的手，且把手刺透；埃及王法郎对所有依靠他的人，就是这样。

text_en: But if you say to me, ‘We rely on the Lord our God, ’ is it not he whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?
text_cn: 假使你们对我说：我们依靠雅威我们的天主，希则克雅岂不是曾推翻他的高丘和祭坛，且对犹大和耶路撒冷说：你们只应在耶路撒冷的这祭坛前朝拜？

text_en: Come now, make a wager with my master the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.
text_cn: 如今你可与我的主上亚述王打赌：我给你两千匹马，你是否能给这些马配上骑兵？

text_en: How then can you repulse a single captain among the least of my master’s servants, when you rely on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
text_cn: 若不能，你怎敢拒绝我主上最小仆人中的一个军长，而去依靠埃及的战车和骑兵？

text_en: Moreover, is it without the Lord that I have come up against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it. ”
text_cn: 现在，我上来攻打毁灭这地，难道不是雅威的意思吗？雅威曾对我说：你上去攻打这地，加以毁灭！”

text_en: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, and Shebnah, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in the Aramaic language, for we understand it; do not speak to us in the language of Judah within the hearing of the people who are on the wall. ”
text_cn: 希耳克雅的儿子厄里雅金、舍布纳和约阿黑对大将军说：“请你对你的仆人说阿剌美话，因为我们都懂；你不要对我们说犹太话，因为城墙上的百姓能听到。”

text_en: But the Rabshakeh said to them, “Has my master sent me to speak these words to your master and to you, and not to the people sitting on the wall, who are doomed with you to eat their own dung and to drink their own urine? ”
text_cn: 大将军回答说：“难道我的主上打发我来，只对你的主上和你讲这些话，而不是对那些坐在城墙上，和你们一样该吃自己的粪，喝自己的尿的人，讲这些话吗？”

text_en: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in the language of Judah, “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!
text_cn: 大将军于是站起来，仍用犹太话大声喊说：“你们听大王亚述王的话吧！

text_en: Thus says the king: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you out of my hand.
text_cn: 大王这样说：你们别上希则克雅的当，他决定不能拯救你们脱离我的手；

text_en: Do not let Hezekiah make you rely on the Lord by saying, The Lord will surely deliver us, and this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria. ’
text_cn: 也不要让希则克雅使你们依靠雅威说：雅威必会拯救我们，这城决不会落在亚述王的手中。

text_en: Do not listen to Hezekiah; for thus says the king of Assyria: ‘Make your peace with me and come out to me; then every one of you will eat from your own vine and your own fig tree, and drink water from your own cistern,
text_cn: 千万别听信希则克雅！原来亚述王曾这样说：你们要与我和好，出来归顺我，各人就可以吃自己的葡萄和无花果，各人也可以喝自己井里的水，

text_en: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive oil and honey, that you may live and not die. Do not listen to Hezekiah when he misleads you by saying, The Lord will deliver us.
text_cn: 直到我来领你们到一个与你们本国一样的地方去，一个有五谷和新酒的地方，一个有食粮和葡萄树的地方，一个产橄榄油和蜂蜜的地方，叫你们生活下去，而不致于死亡。千万别听信希则克雅，因为他欺骗你们说：雅威必拯救我们。

text_en: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered its land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
text_cn: 万国的神中，有那一个由亚述王手中，拯救了自己的国土？

text_en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
text_cn: 哈玛特和阿帕得的神在哪里？色法瓦因、赫纳和依瓦的神在哪里？撒玛黎雅地的神在哪里？难道他们从我手中拯救了撒玛黎雅？

text_en: Who among all the gods of the countries have delivered their countries out of my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand? ’”
text_cn: 在这地域中的神，有那一个由我手中救出了自己的国土？难道雅威就能由我手中拯救耶路撒冷吗？”

text_en: But the people were silent and answered him not a word, for the king’s command was, “Do not answer him. ”
text_cn: 人都不作声，一句话都没有回答他，因为君王有命，不要回答他。

text_en: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace, and Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn and told him the words of the Rabshakeh.
text_cn: 当下希耳克雅的儿子厄里雅金家宰、舍布纳书记和阿撒夫的儿子约阿黑史官，撕裂了自己的衣服，来见希则克雅，将那将军的话全部告诉了他。
